**Blues Scale in the Key of A**

| Note | Interval from Root |
|------|--------------------|
| A    | Root (0 semitones) |
| C    | Minor 3rd (3 semitones) |
| D    | Perfect 4th (5 semitones) |
| D♯   | Blue note / Diminished 5th (6 semitones) |
| E    | Perfect 5th (7 semitones) |
| G    | Minor 7th (10 semitones) |
| A    | Octave (12 semitones) |

**Interval Pattern (in semitones)**  
Root → Minor 3rd → Perfect 4th → Blue note → Perfect 5th → Minor 7th → Octave  
`3 – 2 – 1 – 3 – 2 – 3`

So the A blues scale consists of the notes **A, C, D, D♯, E, G, A**, following the interval pattern above.
